blocks.label: 旧伤修复：原件先由她保管

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 盘你先拿着。我把当时知道的都说清楚。
lines.en: Keep the drive with you. I'll tell you everything I knew then.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: All right. I'll hold it. Start from the beginning.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以后也这样。盘在谁手里，都别把我蒙在鼓里。
lines.en: Same from now on. Whoever holds the drive, don't keep me in the dark.

blocks.label: 旧档和解：把经过和记录摊开

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先把那天的事说完。以后查到什么，记录都给你看。
lines.en: Let me tell you the rest of that day. From now on, you see the records of everything I find.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 从你什么时候看出不对说起。别光挑我不会生气的说。
lines.en: Start with when you first noticed something was wrong. Don't pick only the parts that won't make me angry.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我会看的。答应过的事，你自己记住。
lines.en: I'll read it. You remember what you promised.

blocks.label: 担心办不到：先谈能做的，不自动退出

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我现在没有更稳妥的门路。先说说眼下能做的。
lines.en: I don't have a safer way right now. Let's talk about what we can do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 办不到的先说。别拿没把握的话哄我。
lines.en: Tell me first what you can't do. Don't placate me with maybes.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 眼下只能谈交盘换人。别的还没准信。
lines.en: Right now we can only talk about trading the drive for her release. Nothing else is certain.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就先谈这个。没把握，我听得懂。
lines.en: Then we'll talk about that first. I understand when something isn't certain.

blocks.label: 侍从告白：温柔接住她的心意

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就过来。以后想见我，不必先找差事。
lines.en: Then come here. You don't need an errand as an excuse to see me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 活我照样会干。别一答应，就把我的位置收走。
lines.en: I'll still do the work. Don't think agreeing means you can take my position away.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 位置给你留着。我也喜欢你，听清楚了？
lines.en: Your place stays yours. I love you too. Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: I heard. Keep your voice down.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢你。别再拿擦柜台作借口了。
lines.en: I love you too. Stop using the counter as an excuse.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.en: You counted, and you still waited for me to say it first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.en: Then I won't wait now. Give me your hand.
